title: Lesson 1: Environment & 2D/3D Movement Basics in C#
body:
Welcome to nurma. Setting up .NET SDK and writing our first player controller script.

Basic Movement Script:

using Godot;
using System;

public partial class Player3D : CharacterBody3D
{
    [Export] private float Speed = 5.0f;

    public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
    {
        Vector3 vel = Velocity;
        Vector2 input = Input.GetVector("ui_left", "ui_right", "ui_up", "ui_down");
        Vector3 dir = new Vector3(input.X, 0, input.Y).Normalized();

        if (dir != Vector3.Zero)
        {
            vel.X = dir.X * Speed;
            vel.Z = dir.Z * Speed;
        }
        else
        {
            vel.X = Mathf.MoveToward(Velocity.X, 0, Speed);
            vel.Z = Mathf.MoveToward(Velocity.Z, 0, Speed);
        }
        Velocity = vel;
        MoveAndSlide();
    }
}

title: Lesson 2: Double Jump, Dash & Advanced Camera
body:
Implementing double jump mechanics and dash controls.

Double Jump Code:

using Godot;
using System;

public partial class PlayerAdvanced : CharacterBody3D
{
    [Export] private float JumpForce = 4.5f;
    private bool canDoubleJump = false;

    public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
    {
        Vector3 vel = Velocity;
        if (!IsOnFloor()) vel += GetGravity() * (float)delta;
        else canDoubleJump = true;

        if (Input.IsActionJustPressed("ui_accept"))
        {
            if (IsOnFloor()) { vel.Y = JumpForce; }
            else if (canDoubleJump) { vel.Y = JumpForce * 0.85f; canDoubleJump = false; }
        }
        Velocity = vel;
        MoveAndSlide();
    }
}
